title: Ivo and the Portrait
author: Tamsin Thornbury
blurb: Xanthe Eriksen, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
